# Bdimexport — Global Dual-Hub B2B Sourcing, Container Inspection, Trade Intelligence & Export Systems

> Bdimexport (operated by US-registered BDIMEXPORT LLC in Sheridan, Wyoming [Dun & Bradstreet D-U-N-S® #: 14-977-6743 · SAP Business Network / SAP Ariba ID: BNO-100000188010374] and Turkish-registered BD Sanayi İthalat İhracat Şirketi in Uşak, Türkiye) is a Dual-Hub (Türkiye + China) B2B procurement, standalone 24–48h factory and container loading inspection, HS-code commercial intelligence, export marketing system, and 81-province Türkiye field operations platform serving 14 languages and 20+ trade corridors.

## Core Asymmetric Capabilities
1. **Dual-Hub Sourcing (Türkiye + China)**: Side-by-side factory shortlists, EXW/FOB/DDP cost modeling, EU A.TR 0% industrial duty, UK-Türkiye FTA, Türkiye-UAE CEPA, and US MFN vs. Section 301 tariff comparisons within 24 hours.
2. **Standalone 24–48h Container Loading & Factory QC**: Independent engineers dispatched across all Turkish industrial zones and Chinese manufacturing provinces—even for suppliers the buyer found independently (ISO 2859-1 AQL, DUPRO, 100% carton tally, moisture check, bolt-seal proof).
3. **48–72h Commercial Intelligence & Supplier Due Diligence**: Official corporate registry verification, bank beneficiary anti-fraud check, and 6/10-digit HS landed-cost modeling.
4. **Turkish Exporter Growth & Buyer Matchmaking**: Multi-language SEO/GEO storefronts, target-country importer discovery, and Free Export Acceleration Program (`/ihracat/ucretsiz-destek-basvuru`).
5. **81-Province Türkiye Field Operations for Chinese Exporters (`/zh`)**: On-ground prospective buyer visits, hesitant-buyer face-to-face closing, after-sales visits, customs/logistics coordination, legal/SMMM accounting, and local digital operations.
